chunks: From him, from Fadala, from Aban, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a woman and her husband when a house fell upon both of them, similarly.
ai.seo_question: How is inheritance divided when a husband and wife die at the same time?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the presumption of simultaneous death (*tamanu*) when a husband and wife perish in a single catastrophic event like a collapsing building. This ruling is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for resolving the circular inheritance issue, ensuring that each spouse’s share is distributed to their respective heirs without requiring proof of who died first.
